steps.title: Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Expand the source-system sample on the affected pool
Case: B0011 · Finding: bad loans are being reported as good ones (high confidence)
Action: Increase the servicer-system sample to at least 200 loans and compare status field by field.
Based on:
  - Servicer-system pull: 5 of 60 sampled 'eligible' loans are actually 60+ days late or no longer active [ref S2-B0011-SOURCE_MISMATCH-c40dd8c0]
  - Setpoint PledgeCheck: actual collections don't match what the borrower reported [ref S1-B0011-PLEDGECHECK_COMPLETENESS_FAIL-c1464b80]
  - 5 loans flagged 'deferred' with no disclosed deferment programme [ref S2-B0011-DEFERMENT_WITHOUT_PROGRAM-da636e1d]
  - 7.1% of loans reported current had no payment arrive (25 of 352) [ref S2-B0011-CURRENT_WITHOUT_PAYMENT-a4c84661]

Due: 2026-09-14 · Requires approval before it is carried out.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
